<details>
<summary>🎨 <b>Today's Design Lesson: Chroma Control — Vivid on Muted</b></summary>
<br/>

> Pastel accents (high lightness, medium chroma) on a low-chroma dark base. The lesson: controlling chroma independently of lightness is the mark of a skilled colorist. The accents feel bright and modern without being aggressive. This is the antidote to both boring greys and neon-slop.
